incidents.body: UKMTO has received a report of an incident 25NM Northeast of Khasab, Oman in the Strait of Hormuz. A third-party has reported that a vessel transiting outbound is on fire, the cause is unknown at time of report. Status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at present. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
A Company Security Officer has informed UKMTO that their tanker has been struck by
an unknown projectile whilst completing an outbound transit of the Strait of Hormuz.
There are no reported injuries to the crew or environmental impact report at this time.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident occurring in the Strait of Hormuz, 9NM
north of Khasab, Oman. The Master of a third-party vessel has reported sighting
another vessel on fire.
Status of crew is unknown. There is no damage assessment or environmental impact
UPDATE 001: Regional authorities have identified the vessel as a dhow, which was involved in a

UKMTO has received reports from various sources of suspicious activity within the Gulf
of Aden. Potentially indicative of Pirate Action Group Activity.
Reports describe several sightings of suspicious small craft operating in the vicinity of
merchant vessels. One report describes a green and blue boat with two ladders and one
hook with 9 persons onboard.
Vessels transiting the area are advised to transit with caution, follow guidance written
in BMP MS and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
Authorities are investigating.

UKMTO has received a verified time-late report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
A tanker transiting outbound was struck by an unknown projectile, disabling the vessel. The crew have been reported safe. There is no damage assessment or environmental impact report at present.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO WARNING 181-26 ATTACK
Incident Date: 22 OCT 2026 Incident Time: 1715UTC
UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 7NM northeast of Limah, Oman.
A tanker has reported being hit by an unknown projectile whilst transiting outbound in
the Strait of Hormuz.
The tanker was able to continue its voyage to the next port of call.

UKMTO WARNING 179-26 - ATTACK
Incident Date:21 Oct 2026
Incident Time:0145UTC
Local Authorities
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 11NM west of Bukha, Oman.
Local Authorities have reported that a Tanker has been struck by an unknown projectile
which started a fire which has been extinguished. The Tanker is now at anchor.
All crew are reported as safe. There is no reported environmental impact at this time.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO,
whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker and military forces
approximately 121NM east of Duqm, Oman.
Reports indicate that the tanker was subject to interaction as part of ongoing military
activity in the region. Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.
Vessels are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and maintain
awareness of the evolving operational environment.

UKMTO WARNING 177-26 - ATTACK
Incident Date: 18 OCT 2026 Incident Time: TBC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident northeast of Khor Fakkan, UAE.
A tug travelling southbound has reported being struck by 2 unknown projectiles.
The tug has sustained damage but is continuing on its route. One minor casualty has been reported.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident 140NM southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen.
A Master of an LNG Tanker has reported being approached by a small skiff with seven persons onboard. The skiff fired two shots at the tanker whose armed Security Team fired two warning shots at the small skiff which forced them to alter course.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident 78NM northeast of Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia.
The Master of a tanker has reported being attacked by an RPG from a small boat, resulting in damage to the aft port quarter. Crew are accounted for and reported safe. A complete damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at time of report.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 68NM northeast of Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia of a tanker stuck by an unknown projectile.
All crew are reported safe and have been evacuated. There is no reported environmental impact at time of report.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO while authorities are investigating.

passage.
Authorities are investigating.

UKMTO.

UKMTO Suspicious Activity 165-26
UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the vicinity of Sohar anchorage, Oman.
The status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at time of report.
Update 001:
UKMTO has reclassified this incident as an attack following confirmation that the tanker was struck by an Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV). Local authorities are assisting in the evacuation of the crew, damage assessment and environmental impact is unknown at time of update.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO ADVISORY 152-26 SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY
Incident Date: 05 OCT 2026 Incident Time: 0827UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 11NM north of Khasab, Oman.
A tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz inbound was hailed by the IRGC and instructed to turn back or the vessel would be targeted. The Master of the tanker has confirmed that they have complied with the instruction.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
